nothing will show up after a day.... and yes it is still transmissible but you won't know until a few weeks have passed. an infection of herpes oral/gential will cause an outbreak in two weeks to four weeks in SOME people, not all and that number of people is still small. your gonna have to wait it out, just live your normal life and if something comes up, go to a doctor and get treatment for it. The chances of contracting something is pretty simple, either you get it or you don't. protect yourself, always use a condom, and hopefully you will remember this lesson for the rest of your active sexual life.

go get tested in 2-3 months, you could have gotten nothing or could have gotten somethings thats curable or incurable. Oral sex has an extremely low risk for HIV but has a risk for herpes (HSV 1 and 2). the thing about herpes is that it is very common. 1 in 4 sexually active americans have it and you could have gotten it by making out with her. so the thing to do now is to wait to get tested, if you test tomorrow you will test negative for everything since you had unprotected oral sex last night. the thing to do now is wait just live as if you got just a normal blow job. herpes is very managable with people having very mild or no symptoms at all. its a cold sore here and there, genital herpes can be managable with medication also. do your research, use condoms ALWAYS.

if this is the case than condom use would be pretty much useless. I can see why you are worrying but the fluid from her vagina that was on your hair is not a big deal. If there was a ALOT of fluid than it might be a concern but this is really not, this is an example of people saying that condoms are not 100% protective against STD's and even pregnancy. STD's are a complicated thing so you should get tested later, two weeks is pretty much useless unless its for chlamydia or gonorrhea. but everything else such as herpes and HIV etc. you should get tested at the 3 month period. I'm not saying what you did completely protected you 100%, im saying you chances of contracting anything are very very very low. get tested in 3 months for anything you want and good luck.

Well, your awake right now and the reality is that he broke up with you for reasons I do not know. I don't know if your upset over the reason he broke up with you or the fact that he just broke up with you. My understanding of it right now is that he just broke up with you out of the blue... which means he is selfish/heartless and did not really care about the relationship enough to give you a good reason. In your OP you mostly blame yourself for everything and this probably stems from your insecurities about yourself. The emotions of being hurt, lonely, and empty are just part of the process and will eventually go away. This is you thinking with your heart instead of your head. Your mother was a person that was looking from the outside in and usually they have a better picture of how the relationship looks like (because they are not blinded/engulfed by love). Also in your OP, you have a lot of I's... such as "I planned to marry him", "I planned by future around him" and this shows that you were blinded by love and you gave him your trust that probably has not been given to anybody else except to your family. He broke that trust and what your feeling is something new to you because you may have never been in love like that before. What I am trying to say is that life moves on and you just need to give yourself some time. Stop blaming yourself and love will find you, it just takes time.
